items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I’d like to see Mr. Tommy Dorsey please.

ctx.x: Well after this change of career perhaps, you proceeded in a short number of years to play with a really wide variety of people, from Benny Goodman to Charles Mingus in the space of about a year?

As a matter of fact at the same time, during the same time. Benny Goodman came about as a result of, I think Teddy Wilson or somebody said no. He was supposed to do the Brussels Worlds Fair or do a tour in Europe. And somebody that he would normally call canceled and said no. And so he had the idea to call Juilliard and see if he could get some young person. And it just so happened that I was there at the time, and one of the teachers, the dance instructor, was a friend of Benny’s. She was a friend of Muriel…
That’s a good thing I think.
